notes.title: Dream Gallery - Spirits of Triumph - -MEGA UPDATE-
notes.content:
📅 Date Mode: Explore the Essence of Art!
Experience romantic moments in the art gallery with our new "Date Mode." It provides the perfect ambiance for unforgettable moments with your loved ones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105523/0f3bbffde2d0f7f77b6ce01bb3fea0f44ed28d33.png

🐞 A Lot Of Bug Fixes: Enhancing the Perfection of Art!
We've fixed various bugs to make your experience in the Dream Gallery smoother and more enjoyable. Now you can fully immerse yourself in every detail of the gallery.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105523/f8a63295e8aac04fd68cd93095230708b849e09d.png

💻 Laptop Enhancements: Delve Deeper into the World of Art!
Explore the art world further with new pages added to the laptop. We're enriching your gallery experience with artist profiles, gallery events, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105523/6c93433fe60eda7e3c17f9ba99c4c1f17e4eec8c.png

🎰 Casino and Games: Test Your Luck!
The Dream Gallery now features a casino where you can have fun! Exciting games like Blackjack and slot machines await you. Test your luck to win big prizes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105523/c0b90df596d7ebbdf7f6339c1200d6d4328d73c1.png

💈 Barber and Racing Venue: Places Carrying the Spirit of Art!
Feel the essence of art while getting your hair styled at the newly added barber. Additionally, enjoy quick and thrilling races around the gallery at the racing venue. Chat with NPCs and embark on art-filled adventures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105523/0261bb3f97002397579c092e7436a835a521d9d2.png

Don't miss out on the Dream Gallery - Spirits of Triumph update, where art and entertainment blend seamlessly! We look forward to welcoming you to our gallery. 🎨✨

notes.title: Dealership Simulator 2.0 HUGE UPDATE!
notes.content:
Dealership Simulator 2.0: Coastal Town Express Update 🚗🏝️

Embark on the ultimate automotive journey with Dealership Simulator! Unleash excitement in Coastal Town, indulge in casino thrills, and ignite your creativity with car customization. Embrace the Repair Workshop and breathe life into your vehicles. Join now for an unparalleled automotive adventure! 🌟🎰🔧

Discover Coastal Town:
Escape the city's chaos and relish the serenity of our picturesque coastal haven. Drive on sandy shores, unearth exclusive car opportunities, and find solace in this idyllic paradise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105523/ed411ab5589feeb043a3819582d271480a15bb1f.png

Casino Thrills Await:
Feel the allure of Las Vegas at our brand-new casino section. Try your luck, earn rewards, and get closer to your dream car. Spin the wheel of fortune and drive home in that coveted red sports car! 💰

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105523/b644ac95a58f778a01194760abc9a4d7bc0280d5.png

Customize Your Cars:
Beyond mere purchases, now elevate your rides to reflect your style. With endless customization options, transform your cars into awe-inspiring masterpieces and make heads turn on the streets. 🚗✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105523/735711322e4edd052c82031711ea8b3320a24cdd.png

Revive in the Repair Workshop:
Experience an unforgettable repair journey at our dedicated workshop. Overhaul damaged cars, install new parts, and restore them to pristine conditions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105523/644e1e091d2e27dccde83ec72781379ab6862d4c.png

Get ready for an incredible update packed with surprises. Dealership Simulator 2.0: Coastal Town Express awaits! 🚀 Thank you for your unwavering support; your feedback drives us forward.

Join the Dealership Simulator NOW!!!
